page.overview:
Who is Claudia?

Claudia was the mother of Casey. On October 31, 1998, Claudia's daughter needed to use a restroom, and so they stopped at an isolated rest area. Claudia noticed that another car was there. The women's room was locked, and Claudia opted for them to use the men's room, placing a rock against the door to keep it open.

As soon as Claudia and Casey stepped into their respective stalls, mass murderer Michael Myers — back on the warpath following a 20-year layoff — came into the restroom and closed the door, then swiped Claudia's pocketbook. Fearing for her daughter's life, as well as her own, Claudia caught a glimpse of Michael's white mask as he exited the restroom.

Seconds later, Claudia grew frightened when she heard Casey screaming in apparent terror. However, Casey was only screaming because spiders had fallen on her head, thus relieving Claudia, whose car was promptly stolen by the resurfaced maniac, Michael. [[#cite_note-0|[​1]​]]​
